programme.desc: Travel through Canada, Mexico and the United States. We will visit all sixteen cities where FIFA World Cup matches will be played in 2026. We will get to know the people living there, their culture and the atmosphere there... Switzerland. 2025. series of reports

programme.title: Football: World Cup 2026 – round of 16 match: England – Democratic Republic of Congo
programme.desc: The Democratic Republic of Congo has already made history by reaching the knockout stages of the World Cup for only the first time. She achieved this even though she had only a point before the last round. In the 1/16 finals, it will face a top-class opponent - England, which won Group E. However, in a draw with Portugal, the Leopards showed that they are not afraid of such challenges

programme.title: World Cup morning | E21
programme.desc: The World Championships held in North America may be a challenge for Polish fans, as some of the matches will take place at night. W. football magazine

programme.title: Football: World Cup 2026 – Round of 16 match: Belgium – Senegal
programme.desc: The winner of Group G and the third team in Group I will face each other at Seattle Stadium. Before the start of the World Cup, the Belgians would have been considered favorites in this match, but now it is no longer so obvious. In the previous round of the tournament, the Red Devils did not show anything that would confirm their status. They won only one of three matches against not-so-strong rivals. It remains to be seen whether this was just a smokescreen before the knockout stage or a real picture of the current capabilities of Kevin De Bruyne and company. To beat Senegal, Rudi Garcia's team must show much better football than in the group clashes with Egypt, Iran and New Zealand. The Teranga Lions have already shown at this World Cup that they have huge potential. If they release him in the match against the Belgians, we may see them in the 1/8 finals

programme.title: Traditional karate: Polish Championships - Pruszków 2026
programme.desc: Hala Znicz in Pruszków hosts the 37th edition of the Polish Traditional Karate Championships. Over 400 athletes will take part in the competition. Individual competition will take place in kata, kumite and fukugo formulas

programme.title: Women's football: European Under-19 Championship - Bosnia and Herzegovina 2026: Poland - Germany
programme.desc: Our under-19 women's team continues to participate in the Old Continent championship. Behind her is a meeting with the Swedish women. In the second match, the Poles will face the German team, which is participating in the Euro for the 21st time.

programme.desc: reportage

programme.title: Football: World Cup 2026 – round of 16 match
programme.desc: The knockout phase begins with a match at Los Angeles Stadium. The teams that took second place in groups A and B will face each other. The Canadian national team has a chance to play in this match. For the tournament co-hosts, it would be the biggest success at the World Cup, as they have never made it out of the group so far

programme.title: A day at the World Cup | E21
programme.desc: The program includes the most important events from the World Cup arenas, analyzes and comments on past matches. Journalists and experts will also announce upcoming matches, present the lineups and tactics of individual teams... football magazine

programme.title: Football: World Cup 2026 – Round of 16 match: Spain – Austria
programme.desc: The Spanish national team won Group H with seven points. She didn't even concede a goal in three matches. Despite this, experts and fans had many comments about her game. The La Roja team is fighting for promotion to the best sixteen of the tournament. Lamine Yamal and company will face Austria, which has reached the knockout stage by a single shot. She scored the decisive goal in the 96th minute of the match against Algeria (3-3) in the last series of games in Group J. Will that goal by Sasa Kalajdzic make Ralf Rangnick's team gain wind and throw the main candidate for the gold medal out of the tournament? The winner of the battle at Los Angeles Stadium will play against the better team, Portugal-Croatia, in the next round of the World Cup.

programme.title: Football: World Cup 2026 – Round of 16 match: Portugal – Croatia
programme.desc: The most interesting match of the 1/16 finals. The Croatians, medalists of the two previous world championships, recorded results in the group phase that were consistent with experts' predictions. They lost to the English (2:4) and defeated Panama (1:0) and Ghana (2:1). The Firemen are considered a tournament team that shows its full football potential when it is necessary. The match against Portugal will certainly require Luka Modric and company to reach the heights of their skills. Robert Martinez's team won only one of three matches in group K, and as a result, Colombia overtook them in the table. This does not mean, however, that the team from the Iberian Peninsula cannot achieve success in the American tournament. After all, it has many football stars in its squad who can single-handedly decide the fate of the match. The biggest of them is, of course, Cristiano Ronaldo. Striker Al-Nassr has already made football history as the one who scored in six World Cups

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: GKS Katowice – Arka Gdynia
programme.desc: A week ago, Arka Gdynia defeated Pogoń Szczecin 2:1. It was the newcomer's first victory in this campaign. The players of GKS Katowice, who lost to Legia in Warsaw last weekend, are waiting for their premiere win.

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Motor Lublin – Piast Gliwice
programme.desc: Piast Gliwice players played only two matches this season. Both matches ended with defeats for the team led by Max Mölder. The team from Gliwice will look for a breakthrough in the confrontation with Motor Lublin, which drew 3-3 with Lechia in the previous round after an impressive show.

programme.desc: A decent start of the season by Bruk-Bet Termalika Nieciecza must please the Słoniks' fans. The Ekstraklasa newcomer is at the top and can approach the match against Raków Częstochowa without any reservations, who still cannot stabilize their form.

The Polish champions still have a chance to advance to the Europa League. Before that, however, they will fight for league points in a confrontation with Korona Kielce

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: KGHM Zagłębie Lubin – Lechia Gdańsk
programme.desc: Last season, Lechia Gdańsk was not sure of staying in the PKO BP Ekstraklasa for a long time. The goal of the Tri-City club for the current competition is to secure league status as early as possible. For now, things are not going well for John Carver's players. programme.title: I was a king - Tomasz Frankowski
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. The hero of the next episode is Tomasz Frankowski. The striker won the title of top scorer in the Ekstraklasa four times and won the Polish championship five times with Wisła Kraków. In total, he scored 168 goals in the league. Frankowski is a symbol of the golden era of the Krakow club. We will also see his performances in Jagiellonia Białystok. The authors also return to the famous decision to omit him from the World Cup squad. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Hero from the Shadows – Wisła Płock | E01
programme.desc: Seria przybliża sylwetki osób pracujących za kulisami polskich klubów piłkarskich. Wykonują one bardzo ważne, niezbędne dla funkcjonowania drużyny obowiązki, które często są niewidoczne dla ludzi z zewnątrz. Irena Rosińska has been working at Wisła Płock for almost four decades, being the longest-serving person at the club. Jest kitmanką, czyli dba o zaopatrzenie w sprzęt drużyny. Od 17 lat w codziennych obowiązkach w magazynie pomaga jej córka Magdalena Pawlak. Obie panie tworzą zgrany duet, który jest doceniany i lubiany zarówno przez pracowników, jak i piłkarzy. Poland. documentary series

programme.title: I was the king – Marcin Robak | S01E06
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Marcin Robak is a two-time top scorer in the Ekstraklasa. He is the last Pole to win this title so far. In total, he scored 120 goals in the top league. Marcin Robak scored 22 goals for Pogoń Szczecin in the 2013/2014 season. He finished the 2016/2017 season in Lech Poznań with 18 goals. He then had to share the crown with Marco Paixao. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 1st round singles match: Eva Lys – Emma Navarro
programme.desc: Emma Navarro came to Bad Homburg after a successful tournament in Nottingham. The American reached the final, where she lost to Marie Bouzkova. Now he wants to transfer the form from British courts to German courts. Eva Lys will try to stop her, with whom she will face for the first time in her career. The winner of this match will compete with Iga Świątek in the second round

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 2nd round singles match: Wang Xinyu – Leylah Fernandez
programme.desc: Wang Xinyu started her fight with a confident victory against Renata Zarazua. Now the Chinese woman will face the higher-ranked Leylah Fernandez, whom she will face for the first time in her career. The winner of this match will compete with Elina Svitolina in the quarterfinals

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 2nd round singles match: Naomi Osaka – Elise Mertens
programme.desc: Both women last met on the court in 2024 in Toronto. At that time, Elise Mertens was on top, defeating Naomi Osaka 6:3, 6:4. In Bad Homburg, the Belgian wants to repeat this result and thus reach the quarterfinals

programme.title: Tennis: WTA Tournament in Bad Homburg – 2nd round singles match: Lyudmila Samsonova – Elina Svitolina
programme.desc: Elina Svitolina has already entered one quarterfinal during this year's competition on grass. In Berlin she advanced, defeating Eva Lys. In Bad Homburg, Lyudmila Samsonowa will once again stand in her way, with whom she will face for the first time in her career

programme.desc: Stories of people who encountered and recorded the most dangerous weather phenomena. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Big Brother Oasis | E02
programme.desc: A nature series devoted to the world's first artificial waterhole and the animals that use it. It was created in a reserve in Tanzania, an area of ​​the African savannah with poor water resources. It is not only an excellent vantage point for hidden cameras, but also a place of respite for wild animals such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos. Thanks to hidden cameras, scientists want to track the secret behaviors of creatures gathering around the waterhole. They are wondering, among other things: whether half-year changes affect their customs and how predators and their prey coexist on a daily basis. During the hottest season of the year, thirsty animals come to water only in the evening and at night. It is cooler during this time. However, water-hungry creatures must be careful because they may encounter hyenas under the cover of darkness. Great Britain, USA. 2020. nature series

programme.title: Lycaons: herd vs. rest of the world 2 – Lost member of the Manzi pack | S02E03
programme.desc: Filmmaker and documentarian Julz Braatvedt again visits the charming areas of South Luangwa National Park in Zambia. He observes the everyday life and habits of three herds of wild wild lions and their interactions with other representatives of the local fauna. Viewers will see how the Kakumbi, Manzi and Kakula teams cope with the challenges of Zambian nature. He became separated from the rest of the group and lost his tracking collar. Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Lycaons: herd vs. rest of the world 2 – Kakumbi are in trouble | S02E04

programme.desc: «The league of... (T1): All the president's ultras» The presidents attend, astonished, the appearance in Spain of the ultra fans movement. They don't really know how to relate to them, but they are clear that they don't want them against them. To keep them happy, they give them privileges; After all, presidents are the first fans. Joan Gaspart, former president of the F.C. Barcelona boasts of being one of the Boixos Nois, the ultras of Barça. At the same time, their egos invite them to challenge each other, with cocky attitudes that begin with mockery and end in punches. These presidential attitudes are reproduced in the stadiums: dirty play, insults to the referee and racist chants are the order of the day. In this spiral of violence, the ultras cross the red line with physical attacks that end with the murder of Aitor Zabaleta. This death will mark a turning point, and the presidents will have to decide whether to protect or confront this monster that they themselves fed.

programme.desc: «Plus+ Report (20/21): The silver of Los Angeles» In the 1980s, Spain tried to leave the Franco dictatorship behind and become tinged with modernity. Until the explosion of the Barcelona 92 ​​Olympic Games, the medals that Spain won in the Games could be counted on the fingers of one hand. The 1984 Los Angeles Olympics were no exception. But one of the medals achieved in the Californian city stirred the passion of an entire country. In August 1984, many classrooms remained with the lights on at dawn. The reason, the enthusiasm that the men's basketball team had aroused. That championship changed the lives of twelve players and one coach, Antonio Díaz-Miguel, and transformed basketball in our country forever.

Atomic Dog» Originally from Jackson (Mississippi), a state in the deep American south, Audie Norris (1960) is considered the best foreign player for Barça basketball. In the six years he was in the Barça team he won three leagues and two King's Cups. He spent three seasons in the NBA, in Portland, the same city and the same team where Fernando Martín played. Two players who revitalized a sport with their colossal duels in the paint. He was fired from Barça in 1993. A year later, in the Greek Peristeri, he left basketball because of his knees, the only ones that managed to stop him on the court and which tormented him throughout his entire career. He returned to the US. Bad investments left him on the brink of bankruptcy. He decided to turn his life around and return to the city that saw him shine. And 28 years after being fired he has returned to the club of his life. Since 2021 he has been a Barça ambassador

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Two Escobars
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/s Airport Security: First Class (Almost broke free)

To deceive customs officers, a cargo of cocaine is disguised as a certain chemical composition. USA

programme.title: d/s Airport Security 3: Peru. 16 p.
programme.desc: A US citizen is arrested with a load of cocaine - and the story doesn't end there. A woman with cocaine in her purse agrees to cooperate, and another suspect falls into the hands of the police. The Japanese karaoke star is bringing more than music with her; her mother is getting involved. As a result, everything turns out to be a false alarm. Peru

programme.title: d/s Airport Security 3: Peru. 15 s.
programme.desc: In this series, employees of the anti-smuggling and drug trafficking service at the international airport named after. Jorge Chavez in Lima, Peru, is faced with an unusual and very dramatic situation when they are forced to arrest a woman with two small children who was trying to sell cocaine. Next, you will see a scene of the arrest of an elderly man, which indicates the attempts of the drug cartels to find new ways of smuggling. A young woman sobs as she is detained for attempting to smuggle contraband. A young man, previously convicted of trying to smuggle drugs into the United Arab Emirates, arouses suspicion among the officers, and they decide to question him. In the hand luggage inspection area, a handicraft from Peru turns out to be a hiding place for drug trafficking. A Chinese national who tried to persuade security officials not to check his cargo of Peruvian maca nutritional supplements will have to deal with the consequences of his actions. Peru

programme.title: d/s Airport Security 3: Peru. 14 p.
programme.desc: In this episode, narcotics agents at Jorge Chevez International Airport in Lima, Peru, apprehend a young woman whose nervous behavior makes them suspicious. Another young woman bursts into tears and swears she was tricked into drug smuggling. A passenger claims he broke the law out of necessity; another passenger is considering cooperating with the police to see if this could reduce his future prison sentence. In the office, the services are examining the contents of the suitcase, which is some kind of mysterious substance. To identify it, agents invite experts with a chemical background, who will have to determine the legality of transporting this substance. Peru

programme.title: d/s Airport Security 3: Peru. 13 p.
programme.desc: In this episode, anti-drug agents at Jorge Chevez International Airport in Lima, Peru encounter a unique method of smuggling contraband. Other officers detain an Indonesian woman and are faced with a language barrier. A passenger is carrying what looks like adorable baby diapers, but they turn out to be filled with drugs. At the cargo dock, the 24-box cargo is scanned by a drug-sniffing dog. Two young passengers are detained during rush hour at an international airport right next to the drug enforcement office. Peru

Zambia Untamed: Mvula's Journey (S1E4). Documentary about nature. USA, 2018. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: JAV. Год: 2018. S1, Ep4 «Zambia Untamed»…Mvula is the youngest calf in the Madzi family. Temperatures are soaring. Lagoons and waterholes are drying up. This forces Mvula and his family to undertake a long and dangerous journey to the only remaining source of water: the Luangwa RiverIn a magical corner of Zambia lies an extraordinary valley – a place where Africa's most charismatic animals live shoulder to shoulder. This series tells enchanting stories about the characters who call this place home, from the struggles of a baby elephant to a baboon born an outsider. From the smallest, to the tallest, a cast of engaging and intriguing animals brings this untamed African wonderland to lifeDirector: Beth Brooks

programme.title: Strange Creatures: Winged Weirdos (S1E2). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2015. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: Kanada, JAV. Год: 2015. S1, Ep2 «Strange Creatures»…Deadly snakes, giant stinky plants, macro shots of bizarre insects – nature is crawling with truly strange creatures. From the venomous shrew that eats 3 times its body weight each day to the cockroach that can live two weeks without its head, the animal kingdom's weirdest and wildest can only be found hereDocumentary series is dedicated to the majestic Animal Kingdom and its weirdest, most unusual creatures. Nature never stops surprising us with its unique species and evolutionary unlike living things. Have a look at species with extraordinary survival skills, animals who camouflage in a skillful way for different reasons, creatures that convincingly play dead, find out if a grasshopper can vomit. These and much more amazing facts about animals are there for you in Strange CreaturesDirector: Chad Barkley, Danielle Heifa

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: Class Reunion (S3E2). Documentary about nature. England, 2023. S3, Ep2
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2023. S3, Ep2 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Follow new graduate Beni, who gets an exciting introduction to jungle college alongside former classmates Sura, Meryl, and Wine. Check on new arrival Molly and join Dr. Nadine as she grades slowpoke Bumi and wild child Monita on their latest lessonsCaptivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School»Director: Judith CurranCast: Rebecca Parr

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue: A Pangolin's Plight (S2E5). Documentary about nature. England, 2022. S2, Ep5
programme.desc: 2022 г. Год: 2022. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2022. S2, Ep5 «Malawi Wildlife Rescue»…Feel heartbreak when Dr. Amanda's team loses a pangolin abused by wildlife traffickers, but cheer when another is released post-rehab. Check on a trio of hedgehogs and tag along as the centre's baboons and nyala antelopes get a change of sceneryMalawi is a small African country that has made a big push to protect its wildlife. Leading the effort is American veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb and her colleagues at the country's only animal rescue center, where injured and abandoned creatures are saved and rehabilitated. This six-part series follows the dedicated team as they care for a variety of patients, including vervet monkeys, bulbuls, baboons, hedgehogs, and many more, often working with limited resources and in dangerous conditions as they prepare the animals to return to the wildDirector: Andie ClareCast: Helen Baxendale, Amanda Salb, Torie Curr Smith

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue: Crocodile Capers (S2E6). Documentary about nature. England, 2022. S2, Ep6

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends: A Friend in Need (S1E2). Documentary about nature. England, 2020. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2020. S1, Ep2 «Amazing Animal Friends»…Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kindAmazing Animal Friends is a heart-warming, fun and fascinating series showcasing the most incredible stories of unusual animal friendships from around the world. From an orphaned rhino calf and her dog and sheep companions in South Africa, to the duck who's obsessed with a dog in France and the elephant who thinks she's a buffalo in Zimbabwe, we reveal the cutest, funniest and unexpected animal relationships in the world. The series discovers what brings these species together, explores how they form their extraordinary bonds and examines the behaviours that influence and affect each relationshipDirector: Chris Harries, Justin PurefoyCast: Kingsley Lara
